notes.title: Path to Serenity - Available to Wishlist!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I’m excited to announce that [b]Path to Serenity [/b]is now available to wishlist on Steam! I’ve been working hard to get the steam page ready, and it’s finally here. You can now add it to your wishlist, and I would really appreciate your support.

While there’s no set release date yet, I’ll be keeping you updated here with news on the game's progress and development.

Feel free to wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265030/Path_to_Serenity/


Announcement trailer:
https://youtu.be/JqA8oW5N8Fk

Thank you for your support, and I’ll see you in the next update!

- Silviu
